videos.title: Emergency Discussion #3:  Xi Visits Trump
videos.description:
In this Zoom discussion, Professor Jiang analyzes President Xi Jinping's visit to the United States.  Why didn't Chinese entrepreneurs accompany him, and why were there no major announcements?  

Professor Jiang argues that President Xi lacks the authority to make any controversial concessions.
